title: 4 Best Electric Kettles for Tea, Coffee and Everyday Use
metaDescription: The best electric kettles for pour-over coffee, tea lovers and simple everyday boiling, with clear strengths and limitations.
lede: If you only boil water for instant coffee or pasta, any reliable kettle will do. If you brew tea or pour-over coffee, temperature control and a gooseneck spout make a real difference. These picks are based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports.

products.searchQuery: Fellow Stagg EKG electric gooseneck kettle

products.blurb: A design-focused gooseneck kettle with precise temperature selection and a hold mode that keeps water at temperature.

howWeChose: We picked one kettle per need: pour-over precision, tea presets, glass design and budget.
Picks are based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports.
We prioritised safety features such as auto shut-off and boil-dry protection.

faqs.q: Do I need a gooseneck kettle?
faqs.a: Only for pour-over coffee, where a slow, controlled pour helps even extraction. For tea and everyday boiling, a standard spout is fine.

faqs.q: Is an electric kettle cheaper than a stovetop kettle?
faqs.a: Electric kettles transfer heat to the water efficiently and switch off automatically, so they are usually quicker and less wasteful than heating water on a stove.
